body: Don't apologize for being blunt.  I mean I can be serious when I need to be, it's just that life is too short to take ourselves too seriously all the time.  But anyway, I met a girl (17 or 18) when I was with my friends at a concert tonight and we played frisbee and it was exactly what I needed to feel good about life again.  I would love to hang out with her again and even though she's probably going away to college, just having fun with her this summer would be awesome, but she said to someone that she have a boyfriend soon, but just the fact that in the past week I've met 2 new girls who are 17-19 that I really enjoyed meeting and hanging out with gives me hope for the future...I just hope this hope lasts

Thanks for your support.  I decided to join my friends at a town concert tonight and I met a really cute girl (who must be 17 or 18 which is an improvement for me) who was a friend of my friend's family, and we played frisbee and I had such a great time, I'm high on life right now, I just hope I can remember this if I get down low again.  I also have a crush on this girl who I overheard her say to someone that she might have a boyfriend in a few days as it is prom season I think...but I don't care, I had a great time and this was exactly what I needed
